meta.title: TCF Simulator - Practise the TCF under real exam conditions
meta.description: 5 complete mock TCF tests, timed like exam day. Score, CEFR level and a detailed correction of every mistake.

hero.subtitle: Fidelity to exam day: server-side timer, autosave, resume after any interruption. Score, estimated CEFR level and an explanation for every mistake.

features.title: A simulation, not a quiz
features.subtitle: Every detail mirrors the exam: time pressure, document reading, immediate analysis of your mistakes.
features.timerBody: Remaining time is computed by the server. Reloading the page, losing the network or switching devices costs you nothing.
features.autosaveBody: Every answer is stored immediately. You resume at exactly the same point.
features.correctionBody: For each question: your answer, the right answer, and above all why. Mistakes turn into progress.
features.analyticsBody: Radar by level, bars by difficulty, time spent per question and a progress curve across the 5 tests.
features.mistakesBody: A targeted session on the questions you got wrong, instead of repeating the whole test.
features.mobileBody: Fully responsive design and an installable app (PWA). Revise on the metro, online or offline.

exam.title: Two modules, like the TCF
exam.subtitle: Each module is timed separately. You move forward one question at a time.
exam.structureBody: Grammar, vocabulary, morphology: complete the sentence with the correct form.
exam.comprehensionBody: Notices, emails, articles, leaflets: read a document then answer its questions.

faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.a1: No. They are original questions created for practice, inspired by the general format of the public TCF. Only France Education international and an accredited centre can award the official TCF.
faq.q2: How is the CEFR level computed?
faq.a2: Using a configurable scale defined in the application code. It is a pedagogical approximation for practice, not the official TCF scale.
faq.q3: What happens if I lose my connection?
faq.a3: Your answers are already stored server-side. Saving resumes as soon as the connection is back. The timer, however, stays authoritative on the server.
faq.q4: Can I pause a test and resume later?
faq.a4: Yes. Each module has its own timer. If you close the page you will find the in-progress attempt with the exact remaining time, as long as the module duration has not elapsed.
faq.q5: How long does a full test take?
faq.a5: 80 minutes in total: 20 minutes for language structure (20 questions) and 60 minutes for reading comprehension (30 questions).
faq.a6: Yes, an account is needed to keep your results, history and progress curve. You can also sign in with Google.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaDescription: What data TCF Simulator collects, why, how long it is kept, and how to exercise your rights.
privacy.intro1: TCF Simulator is a platform for practising the TCF. This policy explains which personal data is processed, for which purposes, and what means you have to control it.
privacy.intro2: TCF Simulator is an independent service. It is not produced, endorsed or operated by France Éducation international, which remains the only body awarding the TCF.
privacy.dataBody: We only collect the data strictly required for the platform to work:
privacy.dataAccount: Your account details: email address, display name, hashed password and interface language.
privacy.dataAttempts: Your test attempts: selected answers, timing, obtained score and estimated CEFR level.
privacy.dataTechnical: Technical browsing data (IP address, browser type) kept for security and technical diagnostics.
privacy.dataNoSell: No data is sold, rented or transferred to third parties for advertising purposes.
privacy.useBody: Your data is used exclusively to provide the service:
privacy.useProvide: Create and secure your account, and let you resume an interrupted test.
privacy.useProgress: Compute your scores, your progress and your personal statistics.
privacy.useSecurity: Detect fraudulent activity and protect the availability of the service.
privacy.hostingBody: The database and the application infrastructure are hosted by a provider located in the European Union. Connection data travels over an encrypted link. Developer access to the database is limited to what is required for operations and is never used to build a profile of you.
privacy.retentionBody: Account data is kept for as long as the account is active. On request, or after a long period of inactivity, the account and its attempts are deleted. Security logs are kept for thirteen months at most.
privacy.rightsBody: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights, all free of charge:
privacy.rightsAccess: obtain a copy of the data concerning you
privacy.rightsErase: request deletion of your account and its content
privacy.rightsPortability: receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
privacy.cookiesBody: A session cookie is set at login so you stay signed in. It is strictly necessary for the service: it is not used for audience measurement or advertising. No third-party advertising cookie is set.
privacy.childrenBody: The platform is intended for an adult audience. Users under sixteen must obtain a legal representative's approval before creating an account.
privacy.contactBody: For any question about your data, or to exercise any of the rights listed above, use the contact form shown on the home page. You will receive a response within one month at most.
